perItemFindings.one_line: `FiniteDesign` only packages a finite pmf (`p`, nonnegativity, total mass); it does not host the fixed binary schedule, observation map, score vectors, or derived score/variance objects that S1 binds.

verbatim_critique: Replan S1 as a local `Setup`/composite world embedding a reused `FiniteDesign` randomization layer. Retain `FiniteDesign` for E/Var/Cov/Pr, but do not label it as the world-level reuse.
